Total revenue increased at a modest pace, driven primarily by strong performance in the company\u2019s core markets. Despite some fluctuations in demand, the business maintained healthy margins, with cost controls and efficiency measures helping to offset any increase in operational expenses. As a result, gross profit grew at a stable rate, keeping in line with management\u2019s expectations.
